B_0: Field where the charge starts, the center of the bottle
B_max: Largest field on the charge's path
B_z: Field component out of the page
K_max: Largest kinetic energy the cyclotron gives
alpha: Pitch angle between the velocity and the field
mu: Magnetic moment of the circling charge, mv⊥²/(2B)
n: Density of charge carriers in the Hall strip
q: Charge of the particle or carrier
